title: Autonomous rendezvous system overcomes simulated spacecraft failures in lab tests
source: Space News - Space, Astronomy, Space Exploration
summary: There is a problem in low Earth orbit, and it's growing. According to the European Space Agency, there are about 19,440 satellites on orbit, 3,540 of which are nonfunctioning and/or not emitting a signal to warn other spacecraft of their location. The need to service these sleepwalking satellites in space will only increase as more are launched.
